scope: Autonomous converted Llama fixture with checked exact F32 weight evaluation and symbolic causal RPN execution

fixture.construction: Independent byte-level GGUF, one layer, embedding width 4, two query heads, one KV head, head dimension 2, nonzero signed MLP, 260-token SentencePiece vocabulary

oracle.method: Independent scalar normalization, projections, GQA attention, RoPE and SwiGLU; F32 KV casts are explicit; no production numeric kernel is called
oracle.generation: Production greedy sampler compared at each step against independently computed maximum-logit index

contracts: No source GGUF or mapping is retained by autonomous model
Configuration, tokenizer and tensor roles use the same validators as GGUF
Every evaluated F32 weight must equal the recognized BML target as an exact rational
Exact decimal 0.1 is rejected rather than silently rounded to F32; 0.5 is accepted
Explicit model materialization cap rejects insufficient capacity
Full and cached forward execute dot, residual_add, rms_norm, rope, scale, softmax and swiglu
limitations: The explicit checked-F32 boundary materializes weights. Activations and KV are numeric, not exact rational inference.
Closed BML terms can fail recognition or numerical evaluation; such failures are returned without fallback.
No real-model conversion/inference, CLI run integration or full mutation-campaign completion is claimed.
